validation_ack.reason: FS2021 (PDF p. 10) prints basic EPS rounded to 3 dp as USD 0.013; no PGN document prints more digits (AR2021-AR2025 all show 0.013). 0.013 x 24,241,508,196 shares = USD 315.1 mn vs profit attributable USD 303.8 mn (3.7% gap) is pure rounding: 303,823,865 / 24,241,508,196 = USD 0.01253. Share count is unchanged since 2008 and there are no treasury shares.

research_notes: Source policy: every FY money figure, EPS and share count comes from that year's own audited consolidated FS (pgn.co.id 'Laporan Keuangan' downloads), except FY2022 EPS which uses the 4-dp comparative in FS2023. EBITDA comes from each year's own AR highlights table; ROE/ROA from AR2025 (2021-2025) and AR2020 (2020); year-end prices from AR2025 (2021-2025) and AR2020 (2020); operating volumes from AR2025 (2021-2025) and AR2021 (2020). Dividends from the company's own IDX/OJK disclosure letters and AGMS minutes summaries published on pgn.co.id. Interim = unaudited 9M 2026 FS (PDF dated 28 Oct 2026) + the 9M results decks for EBITDA.

Currency/units: the FS are presented in full US dollars; all money values here are USD million (exact, 6 dp). DPS is rupiah per share as paid (PGN declares in USD and pays in IDR at the BI middle rate); dividend 'total' is the declared USD amount.

Legal name: EGMS of 29 Dec 2025 (deed 26 Jan 2026, Ministry of Law approval AHU-0004617.AH.01.02.TAHUN 2026 of 29 Jan 2026) changed the name from 'PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk' to 'PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (Persero) Tbk' (9M 2026 FS note 1a, PDF p. 15). FS2025 and AR2025 still carry the old name. The 2018-2025 name without '(Persero)' followed GR 6/2018 (inbreng of the State's shares into Pertamina). Immediate parent PT Pertamina (Persero) holds 56.97%; ultimate parent the Republic of Indonesia (Series A Dwiwarna share).

No corporate actions since 2019-01-01: issued shares are 24,241,508,196 in every FS from FY2019 to 9M 2026; the ARs (e.g. AR2021 p. 30, AR2024 p. 30, AR2025 p. 37) state no stock split, reverse split, bonus, rights issue or buyback. The last split was 13 Jun 2008 (Rp500 -> Rp100 nominal, 1:5), outside the window.

total_debt = printed bank loans + bonds + (2019-2021) Pertagas' interest-bearing shareholder loan from Pertamina (FS note 'Pinjaman/Loans' groups it with bank loans; USD 246.2 mn at end-2019, 210.6 mn end-2020, 50.0 mn end-2021, repaid 2022). Without it total_debt would be 2,504.2 (2019), 2,348.8 (2020) and 2,390.4 (2021) USD mn. The USD senior notes (PGN 5.125% due May 2024, nominal USD 1.35 bn; SEI notes, nominal USD 625 mn; FS2022 note 20) were bought back/repaid in 2022 (cash USD 644.3 mn), 2023 (773.3 mn) and 2024 (553.0 mn): no bonds from FY2024. The 'proceeds of loans from joint ventures' lines in the 2022-2024 cash-flow statements are repayments of a loan receivable from PDG, not borrowings.

EBITDA is never defined beyond footnotes: AR2022 marks its 2022 figure, and AR2023-AR2025 mark 2022 and 2023, as including FX gain/loss and the share of JV profit. AR2022 printed FY2022 EBITDA 1,216.837 while AR2023-AR2025 print 1,218.816 (own-year AR stored). FY2025: table 971.197 vs MD&A text 971.24.

FY2020 was a loss year (attributable loss USD 264.8 mn) because of a USD 278.4 mn provision for tax disputes (FS2020 PDF p. 9); the AGMS of 3 May 2021 approved no FY2020 dividend, so payout_ratio 0 and no dividend record. FY2021 profit includes a USD 65.2 mn reversal of that provision.

Presentation changes (operating profit unchanged in each case): FS2021 reclassified FY2020 'beban niaga dan infrastruktur' into cost of revenues (FY2020 gross profit 854.4 in FS2020 vs 470.0 in FS2021; Note 43); FS2022 reclassified FY2021 current/non-current liabilities (deferred revenue) and restated FY2021 CFO 582.705 -> 581.705; FS2024 re-split FY2023 G&A and other expenses. Own-year values are stored throughout.

operating_profit is PGN's 'Laba operasi', which sits ABOVE share of JV profit (USD 76.4 mn in 2025), finance items, FX, oil & gas impairments (USD 99.5 mn in 2025) and tax/onerous-contract provisions - so it can move very differently from net profit.

capex = cash-flow additions of fixed assets + additions of oil and gas properties only (brief definition). Additions of exploration & evaluation assets are excluded (USD 54.1 mn in 2024, 9.2 mn in 2025 - see each note). PGN's own AR 'Belanja Modal' (e.g. USD 282.4 mn 2025, 255.4 mn 2024) is a broader, accrual-based measure and is not stored.

Operating data: sales_volume = gas trading (niaga) volume in BBTUD; production = oil & gas lifting of PT Saka Energi Indonesia in BOEPD (AR2025 chart labels, 2021-2025). AR2020/AR2021 print FY2020 lifting only as 7.5 MMBOE (annual) - not stored for 2020 because it would need a unit conversion. Gas transmission volume (MMSCFD) has no slot and is recorded in each sales_volume note. 9M 2026 deck: trading 827 BBTUD, transmission 1,623 MMSCFD, lifting 16,476 BOEPD.

Dividend dates: the payment dates in the ARs' dividend tables differ by a day or two from the company's own schedule notices (FY2022: AR 28 Jun vs corrected notice 27 Jun 2023; FY2023: AR 26 Jun vs notice 28 Jun 2024; FY2024: AR 1 Jul vs notice 2 Jul 2025). The notice dates are stored. The FY2023 and FY2024 notices are image-only PDFs, read visually from rendered pages; their DPS agree with FS2024/FS2025 note 26 (IDR148.31 / IDR182.08).

Large non-controlling interests (total equity 3,607.8 vs equity attributable 2,740.4 USD mn at end-2025) largely reflect the 49% of PT Pertamina Gas (Pertagas) that PGN does not own (FS2025 PDF p. 266 lists Pertagas at 51.00%; PGN bought the 51% from Pertamina in 2018 and repaid the related promissory notes in 2019, FS2020 cash flow PDF p. 12). ROE as printed in the AR uses TOTAL equity as denominator (recomputed), so it is lower than profit / equity_attr.
